# Cambridge Advantage

> Cambridge Advantage is a UK-focused business coaching and consulting practice serving owner-led small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) worldwide, delivered entirely remotely. Arjun Bingipur, Profitability Specialist, works with business owners on profit growth, sales conversion, pricing strategy, market positioning, employee productivity, and strategic planning.

Cambridge Advantage helps small and medium-sized business owners become more efficient in the day-to-day running of their business, using low-cost and no-cost tactics that improve bottom-line profit. The practice offers structured coaching programs, one-to-one sessions, and a free introductory Business Breakthrough Session.
